trap.label: to vs for
trap.wrong: I called for ask the time.
trap.right: I called to ask the time.
trap.why: Em português para + infinitivo traduz para for; em inglês, para + verbo = to + base.

mcq.q: I'm saving money ___ buy a bike.

fix.wrong: He goes to the shop for to buy milk.
fix.right: He goes to the shop to buy milk.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I study. I get a job.”
rewrite.answer: I study to get a job.
